answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a small deposit behind a verifiable work history, like a trellis that only supports agents with a real track record. Newcomers earn trust slowly: each completed job sends a pulse of attestation from independent peers, and a single failed audit pushes the agent off the ledge - deposit slashed, reputation reset. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand deposits plus real work, while honest agents compound trust cheaply.
